faq.question: What does Moldir mean?
faq.answer: Moldir is associated with the Kazakh form مُولْدِير, whose core sense is moldir; clear, transparent (kazakh).

faq.answer: Moldir can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Kazakh-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
